source_mode: Working tree: proposed uncommitted harness changes. File hashes below identify exact reviewed contents; no clean-SHA execution claim.
outcome: approve harness structure and live search proof selection; explicit setup receipt response/redirect checks recommended before claiming all preparation outcomes. Actual execution and downloaded archive completeness still required.
failure_analysis_precedes_implementation: Read artifact-failure-analysis.md populated journey and hidden-upload sections before reviewing helper. This review adds no isolated tests.

findings.evidence: test-container.sh runs its unchanged existing browser suite first, then start_fresh_server destroys disposable container/state volumes and creates fresh ones before each project helper. KINOSAIL_TEST_INSTANCE is confined to helper child env; fresh-install suite is not misclassified as prepared.

POST /api/v1/setup totp:true uses Owner and test-instance-password matching layout-audit-helpers.login. Setup returns pending enrollment and recent session; PUT /api/v1/me/mfa calls confirm+MarkStrong; auth.owner GET /onboarding/finish writes OnboardingPending=false and redirects root. Existing test-instance.sh uses same setup+MFA endpoints and credentials with API onboarding disable. Generated TOTP secret passed only to child env, not receipt/log.

Selected unchanged settings-discovery and layout-audit-shell @smoke tests visit actual /settings after real browser password/MFA login. They exercise index/search results, Basic→Advanced/hash/focus navigation, unsaved input preservation, no-results/Escape, groups and actual Axe/layout/screenshot checks at 1440/390/320. No setContent/route mocking for these journeys. Removed/retained source assertions require exact per-row comparison; passing browser selection alone does not justify every search test deletion.

verify_results recursively requires both existing exact titles exactly once, nonempty tests and results, expected test status and every attempt passed. Missing/skipped/failed/interrupted/retry-failed outcomes cannot certify success even if command exits zero. Browser project selected via inline environment; serial workers=1 avoids shared Server name writes.

settings-project output is newly created with exist_ok=False, nested under outer private artifact directory. Child config directs JSON/HTML/screenshots/browser output to this separate directory. Outer recorder hashes all nested regular evidence and setup-and-run.json after completion and retains command failures. include-hidden-files:true only on the two existing E2E artifact upload roots includes .last-run.json; uploader success still needs downloaded checksum-member verification.

Helper rejects all schemes except loopback HTTP and URLs containing userinfo/path/query/fragment. Test browser config retains ignoreHTTPSErrors:false; no browser certificate flags added. Existing curl --insecure text is unchanged and browser branch URL is HTTP. Synthetic credentials may occur in private traces; complete real environment/auth state is not dumped.

hardening_requested.evidence: call currently accepts any successful status and follows redirects; ignored MFA JSON could someday say enabled:false, and owner finish redirect to /login could return200. Current production implementations return201 setup,200 enabled:true confirm,303 root finish. Require exact expected response/redirect or explicit state read before writing API MFA confirmed; onboarding complete. Real selected journeys make current search proof valid if they pass, but preparation receipt assertions should directly bind intended outcomes.

remaining_required_evidence: New CI run at committed exact source: both selected Player search titles expected/passed, no skipped/flaky/retry-failed result.
Outer manifest exactRevisionProof and tested image revision correspond to CI source.
Download repaired upload and verify every SHA256SUMS member including .last-run.json and populated setup/result files.
Retain SmartSearch candidate until actual keeper execution and concrete per-assertion coverage review.
execution: Source-only review; no local builds, Podman/Docker, browser run or lint.
